## Core Philosophy & Principles

Minimalism, Stoicism, Reading, Programming, and Adventure shape how software is built and how content is written.

- **Minimalism** helps focus on what matters
- **Stoicism** teaches acceptance and resilience
- **Reading** expands understanding
- **Programming** creates useful things
- **Adventure** provides perspective

## Areas of Expertise

### Privacy Engineering
Practical techniques for data protection, privacy-by-design, and reducing unnecessary data collection. Focus on making deliberate choices for specific threat models rather than chasing perfect anonymity.

### Security Engineering
Threat modeling, defensive security, account protection, and secure defaults. Security recommendations depend on what you are protecting and from whom — explaining trade-offs, limitations, and safer defaults without pretending one tool fits every threat model.

### Software Engineering
Version control with Git, development workflows, open-source tools, and clean architecture. Emphasis on practical, maintainable approaches.

## Website Technology

This site uses **Hugo** (https://gohugo.io/) with the Bear Cub theme. It draws inspiration from:
- BearBlog (https://bearblog.dev/)
- MidNight (https://midnight.pub/)
- Best Motherf*cking Website (https://bestmotherfucking.website/)

The design is intentionally minimal:
- No heavy fonts
- No unnecessary JavaScript
- No tracking
- Loads fast on any device and any network condition

### Blog Articles

#### [Digital Privacy: A Practical Checklist](https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/blog/privacy-digital-life/)
**Published**: 2025-07-23
**Description**: A practical digital privacy checklist covering operating systems, browsers, email, passwords, networking, and everyday habits.

**Key Sections**:
- **Operating System**: MacOS (Apple ID, FileVault, Homebrew, KnockKnock, LuLu, OverSight, Onyx), Windows (Defender, BleachBit, O&O ShutUp10, BCUninstaller)
- **Password**: 1Password, Bitwarden, KeePassXC (avoid LastPass)
- **Two-Factor Authentication**: Hardware tokens (YubiKey, Nitrokey), software tokens (Aegis, Ente Auth), avoid SMS/Authy
- **Browser**: Firefox (LibreWolf, Mullvad), Brave, ungoogled-chromium
- **Extensions**: uMatrix, uBlock Origin, Decentraleyes, filter lists
- **DNS**: Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Mullvad, AdGuard
- **Email**: Disroot, Autistici, ProtonMail, Tuta, SimpleLogin, AnonAddy
- **Communication**: Signal, Telegram (with caveats)
- **File Sharing**: Nextcloud, Send, SkySend
- **Note Taking**: Standard Notes, Notesnook

#### [Improve Online Privacy on a Budget](https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/blog/privacy-in-budget/)

## Structured Data (JSON-LD)

The website implements the following Schema.org structured data:

### Homepage (WebSite + Person)
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@graph": [
    {
      "@type": "WebSite",
      "@id": "https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/#website",
      "url": "https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/",
      "name": "Anh Khoa",
      "description": "Anh Khoa's blog on privacy engineering, security engineering, and software development. Practical guidance for privacy-first, secure software systems.",
      "publisher": { "@id": "https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/#person" }
    },
    {
      "@type": "Person",
      "@id": "https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/#person",
      "name": "Anh Khoa",
      "url": "https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/",
      "sameAs": [
        "https://github.com/anhkhoakz",
        "https://sr.ht/~anhkhoakz/",
        "https://codeberg.org/anhkhoakz",
        "https://framagit.org/anhkhoakz"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### Blog Posts (BlogPosting)
Each blog post includes BlogPosting schema with:
- headline, description, url, datePublished, dateModified
- author (Person reference)
- publisher (Person reference)
- image (when available)
- article section and tags

### Other Pages (WebPage)
Non-blog pages use WebPage schema with isPartOf referencing the WebSite.

## Technical Configuration

### Canonical URLs
All pages include self-referential canonical tags: `<link rel="canonical" href="[PAGE_URL]" />`

### Robots.txt
- Allows all standard search crawlers
- Manages AI crawler access with specific user-agent rules
- References sitemap at https://www.anhkhoakz.dev/sitemap.xml

### Sitemap
XML sitemap at /sitemap.xml includes all indexable pages with lastmod dates.

### Security Headers (Netlify)
- Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload
- X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
- X-Frame-Options: DENY
- Content-Security-Policy: restrictive policy allowing only self and https:
- Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
- Permissions-Policy: restrictive

### Performance
- Static HTML generation (SSR via Hugo)
- Minified HTML, CSS, JS
- Fingerprinted assets with long-term caching
- Optimized images (WebP, AVIF)
- No client-side rendering required for content
